components.name: List
components.description: A card of Bars. Rows can be links, buttons, selectable options or expandable branches, grouped under sections and split by separators. Pass `items` or compose `ListItem`, `ListSection` and `ListSeparator`.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading at the top of the card, e.g. "Recent".

props.name: leading
props.description: Before the title: an icon or avatar.

props.name: trailing
props.description: End of the title row: a "See all" link, a count, a button.

props.name: footer
props.description: Pinned under the rows, e.g. an "Add" bar.

props.name: items
props.description: Rows as data. Composed `<ListItem>` children work too.

props.name: tree
props.description: Folder-tree layout: a chevron column on every row.

props.name: divided
props.description: Hairline between rows, for settings-style lists.

props.name: value
props.description: Rows with a `value` become selectable; the selected one is active. Controlled with `value`, or kept internally from `defaultValue`.

components.name: ListItem
components.description: One Bar in a List. Nest ListItems inside to make an expandable branch.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading slot: an icon, avatar, status dot.

props.name: active
props.description: Marks the bar as the current one, e.g. the selected nav row.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Replaces the shortcut slot with anything, such as a badge or chevron.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Keyboard hint shown at the end, e.g. "Ctrl+N". Display only.

props.name: description
props.description: Second line under the label. Makes the row two lines tall.

props.name: href
props.description: Renders the row as a link.

props.name: value
props.description: Makes the row selectable within a List that tracks `value`.

props.name: children
props.description: Nested rows. The row becomes an expandable branch.

components.name: ListSection
components.description: A small heading over a group of rows, optionally collapsible.

props.name: trailing
props.description: End of the section heading: a count or an add button.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: The heading toggles the section open and closed.

components.name: ListSeparator
components.description: A hairline between groups of rows.

examples.title: sections · collapsible
examples.code:
<List className="max-w-72" defaultValue="design">
  <ListSection label="Favorites" trailing={count(2)}>
    <ListItem value="inbox" icon={<StarIcon />} label="Starred" />
    <ListItem
      value="mentions"
      icon={<BellIcon />}
      label="Mentions"
      trailing={count(4)}
    />
  </ListSection>
  <ListSection label="Channels" collapsible>
    <ListItem value="general" icon={<HashIcon />} label="general" />
    <ListItem value="design" icon={<HashIcon />} label="design" />
    <ListItem
      value="launch"
      icon={<HashIcon />}
      label="launch"
      trailing={count(12)}
    />
  </ListSection>
  <ListSection label="Archived" collapsible defaultOpen={false}>
    <ListItem value="old" icon={<HashIcon />} label="q2-planning" />
  </ListSection>
</List>

<List className="max-w-64" tone="quiet">
  <ListItem icon={<FileTextIcon />} label="Rename" shortcut="F2" />
  <ListItem icon={<FolderIcon />} label="Move to…" />
  <ListSeparator />
  <ListItem icon={<LockIcon />} label="Lock (admins only)" disabled />
</List>

examples.title: description · divided · links
imports: import { BellIcon, ChevronRightIcon, LockIcon, PaletteIcon, UserIcon } from "lucide-react"
examples.code:
<List divided title="Settings" className="max-w-80">
  {[
    {
      icon: <UserIcon />,
      label: "Account",
      description: "Name, email and photo",
    },
    {
      icon: <LockIcon />,
      label: "Privacy",
      description: "Who can see your activity",
    },
    {
      icon: <PaletteIcon />,
      label: "Appearance",
      description: "Theme, density and font",
    },
    {
      icon: <BellIcon />,
      label: "Notifications",
      description: "Email and push",
    },
  ].map((row) => (
    <ListItem
      key={row.label}
      href="#list"
      {...row}
      trailing={<ChevronRightIcon className="text-muted-foreground" />}
    />
  ))}
</List>
